s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive painful skin lesions and ulcers with systemic symptoms and laboratory abnormalities
salient_findings: Progressive, painful blisters and ulcers of the groin
Enlargement of the tongue with difficulty with mastication
Numbness without weakness of the distal lower limbs
Circinate purpuric patches with erosions on the skin
Hemorrhagic flaccid bullae on the posterior perineum
Low serum zinc level
Subepidermal blister with chronic inflammatory infiltrate and eosinophilic bands on biopsy
key_facts: 1-week history of progressive, painful blisters and ulcers of the groin
3-month history of tongue enlargement
3-month history of numbness without weakness of the distal lower limbs
Difficulty with mastication due to tongue enlargement
Restricted mobility requiring diapers
History of IgG λ-type multiple myeloma
Anemia and lytic lesions in the calvarium
Taking folic acid and intramuscular cyanocobalamin supplements
Platelet count within reference range
Prolonged prothrombin time
Prolonged activated partial thromboplastin time
Low serum zinc level
Subepidermal blister with chronic inflammatory infiltrate and eosinophilic bands on biopsy
Negative direct immunofluorescence test
Negative Herpes simplex virus PCR from perineal ulcer swab

shortlist.label: Paraneoplastic pemphigus
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive painful blisters and ulcers with subepidermal blistering and chronic inflammatory infiltrate on biopsy, in a patient with multiple myeloma

shortlist.label: Multiple myeloma-associated amyloidosis
shortlist.why_kept: History of IgG λ-type multiple myeloma and presence of systemic symptoms such as tongue enlargement and numbness of the distal lower limbs

shortlist.label: Acquired zinc deficiency
shortlist.why_kept: Low serum zinc level and presence of skin lesions and ulcers, which are consistent with zinc deficiency

shortlist.label: Bullous pemphigoid
shortlist.why_kept: Subepidermal blistering and chronic inflammatory infiltrate on biopsy, although the direct immunofluorescence test was negative

shortlist.label: Amyloidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of systemic symptoms such as tongue enlargement and numbness of the distal lower limbs, and biopsy findings showing apple-green birefringence on polarized light microscopy with Congo red staining
